# External data

## SIMPlex: Visium HD, STAY protocol

`SIMPlex/HD/<section>/`: Space Ranger output (`outs/`) of two breast cancer Visium HD sections, `patient4_HD` and `patient5_HD`, from the SIMPlex study, processed with the STAY protocol. The diffusion analysis (`code/figures/diffusion/plot_diffusion_hd.py`) uses the 8 µm bins (`binned_outputs/square_008um/`).

Not tracked by git. Source (currently private):

- https://zenodo.org/records/21497736
